summary: Tote bag snatched from her shoulder in Buenos Aires
story: On July 6 I was walking along Avenida Santa Fe in Buenos Aires when a man on the back of a motorbike pulled my tote bag off my shoulder and they rode away. I went to the tourist police office on Avenida Corrientes that afternoon and made a report. The bag held my headphones, my e-reader and the handheld game console I take on long flights. I have the receipts for all three, and I bought the Electronics Plus add-on for exactly this kind of thing. The tote itself was a gift, so I have no receipt for it, but I have put what it costs in the store.

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Policia de la Ciudad, Comisaria del Turista, Avenida Corrientes 436, Buenos Aires. Report 2026-0714482, made July 6, 2026 at 15:20 by Camille Fontaine, US citizen. Robbery by two men on a motorcycle on Avenida Santa Fe at about 13:40 the same day. One tote bag with headphones, an e-reader and a game console. Suspects not identified.
